notes.vatpase_a1_gpr_standard: meets AGENTS.md section 5 by homology (each S. cerevisiae a isoform forms an active pump on its own; isoform assignment of a1 and a2 has moderate support); does not meet the 2026-09-21 same-compartment substitution recommendation
notes.vatpase_a1_gpr_evidence: 13 of the 15 rule genes are reciprocal best hits of S. cerevisiae V-ATPase subunits (BLAST 2026-11-01; H weakest, 26.8%). The two exceptions: a1 YALI1E12482g, whose best S. cerevisiae hit is VPH1 (876 vs 811 bits over STV1), so its Stv1-type assignment is not reciprocal; and V1 F, which has no W29 protein (CLIB122 Q6C5Q2 best hit VMA7, forward only). The former second branch (a2 and c″) had no V1 head and no c/c′ ring; c″ null loses all activity (Hirata 1997, PMID 9030535), so c″ joins the core. Both S. cerevisiae a isoforms form active pumps (Manolson 1994, PMID 7514599; Kawasaki-Nishi 2001, PMID 11592965; Perzov 2002, PMID 11948198), which meets the AGENTS.md section 5 OR test when carried to Y. lipolytica by homology; same-compartment substitution is partial and one-way (Deschamps 2020, PMC7002768), so the 2026-09-21 same-compartment test is deliberately not met until Y. lipolytica localisation data exist. V0 e YALI1F25663g: reciprocal best hit of Vma9 (61.4%); the e null fails V1-V0 assembly (Compton 2006, PMID 16569636); against: once assembled, e is not needed for coupled pumping in vitro (Bueler 2015, PMID 25546637); its Cas12a guides did not cut (CS -1.60, -0.36) while four Cas9 guides cut and deplete. V1 F YALI0E16192g: the W29 pseudogene call is taken to be a missed 2-nt first exon plus a 56-nt intron, giving an intact ORF when spliced (inferred; no RNA evidence checked) (Fgate-lift).
notes.vatpase_a1_gpr_evidence_tier: orthology (reciprocal BLAST) and S. cerevisiae mutant and biochemical literature; no Y. lipolytica localisation, knockout or complex data; homology-based candidate rule, not a verified native rule
